// Generator for projfile_golden.json. To regenerate, copy into
// internal/projfile as zz_rustfixture_test.go and run from the repo root:
//
//	RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE=$PWD/rust/crates/project/tests/fixtures/projfile_golden.json \
//	  go test ./internal/projfile -run TestDumpRustFixture -count=1
//
// then delete the copy. "edit" cases replay go-toml unstable/edit operations;
// "write" cases run Write's encoder (fresh file or in-place merge).
package projfile

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2/unstable"
	"github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2/unstable/edit"

	"recur/internal/domain"
)

type rustOp struct {
	Op    string   `json:"op"`
	Key   []string `json:"key"`
	Str   *string  `json:"str,omitempty"`
	Raw   *string  `json:"raw,omitempty"`
	Table *string  `json:"table,omitempty"` // {table: v} → map[string]any{table: v}
	Out   string   `json:"out"`
	Err   bool     `json:"err"`
	Found bool     `json:"found"`
}

type rustEdit struct {
	Name  string   `json:"name"`
	Input string   `json:"input"`
	Ops   []rustOp `json:"ops"`
}

type rustWrite struct {
	Name     string         `json:"name"`
	Existing *string        `json:"existing"`
	Project  domain.Project `json:"project"`
	Output   string         `json:"output"`
}

func sp(s string) *string { return &s }

func TestDumpRustFixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE not set")
	}
	ml := "\"\"\"\nline one\nline two\n\"\"\""
	edits := []rustEdit{
		{Name: "replace root string keeps trailing comment", Input: "# head\nsetup_cmd = 'old' # why\nenv = ''\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"setup_cmd"}, Str: sp("new value")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"env"}, Raw: sp(ml)},
		}},
		{Name: "insert after last root kv before tables", Input: "a = 1\n\n# about t\n[t]\nx = 2\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"b"}, Str: sp("it's")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"t", "y"}, Str: sp("q")},
		}},
		{Name: "insert root kv with only sections attached comment", Input: "# keep\n[[run]]\nname = \"dev\"\ncmd = \"make dev\"\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"setup_cmd"}, Str: sp("make setup")},
		}},
		{Name: "insert root kv with detached header comment", Input: "# header\n\n[[run]]\nname = \"dev\"\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"env"}, Raw: sp(ml)},
		}},
		{Name: "insert into empty doc", Input: "", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a"}, Str: sp("x")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"t", "u", "v"}, Str: sp("deep")},
		}},
		{Name: "no trailing newline", Input: "a = 1", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"b"}, Str: sp("x")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"sec", "k"}, Str: sp("y")},
		}},
		{Name: "delete key with attached and detached comments", Input: "# team notes\n\n# about dev\ndev_cmd = \"legacy\" # old\nkeep = 1\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"dev_cmd"}},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"missing"}},
		}},
		{Name: "delete last key absorbs blank lines", Input: "a = 1\n\n\nb = 2\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"b"}},
		}},
		{Name: "delete array of tables", Input: "x = 1\n\n# runs\n[[run]]\nname = 'a'\n\n[[run]]\nname = 'b'\n[run.sub]\nq = 1\n\n[other]\nz = 1\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run"}},
		}},
		{Name: "delete array elements", Input: "[[run]]\nname = 'a'\n\n# second\n[[run]]\nname = 'b'\n\n[[run]]\nname = 'c'\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "2"}},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "0"}},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "5"}},
		}},
		{Name: "set run fields and append element", Input: "setup_cmd = 'x'\n\n[[run]]\n# local override\nname = \"dev\"\ncmd = \"make dev\"\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "0", "cmd"}, Raw: sp(ml)},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "0", "extra"}, Str: sp("e")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "1", "name"}, Str: sp("test")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "1", "cmd"}, Str: sp("go test")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "3", "name"}, Str: sp("oob")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run"}, Str: sp("bad")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "x"}, Str: sp("bad")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "0"}, Str: sp("bad")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "1", "sub", "deep"}, Str: sp("d")},
		}},
		{Name: "inline array of tables", Input: "run = [ { name = \"a\", cmd = \"x\" }, {name='b'} , ] # tail\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "0", "cmd"}, Str: sp("y")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "1", "cmd"}, Raw: sp("'z'")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "2", "name"}, Str: sp("c")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "2", "cmd"}, Str: sp("w")},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "0"}},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "1"}},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "0", "name"}},
		}},
		{Name: "inline array delete only element", Input: "run = [{name = 'a'}]\nx = [1, 2, 3]\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run", "0"}},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"x", "3"}, Str: sp("s")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"x", "0"}, Str: sp("t")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"x", "1", "k"}, Str: sp("bad")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"run", "0", "a", "b"}, Str: sp("nested")},
		}},
		{Name: "inline table dotted group", Input: "t = { a.b = 1, a.c = 2, d = 3 }\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"t", "a", "b"}, Str: sp("one")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"t", "e"}, Str: sp("five")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"t", "a"}, Str: sp("bad")},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"t", "a"}},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"t", "d"}},
		}},
		{Name: "dotted tables extend with dotted keys", Input: "a.b = 1\n\n[s]\nx.y = 1\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a", "c"}, Str: sp("c")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"s", "x", "z"}, Str: sp("z")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"s", "n", "m"}, Str: sp("m")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a"}, Str: sp("bad")},
		}},
		{Name: "implicit table header", Input: "[a.b]\nx = 1\n\n[z]\ny = 2\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a", "c"}, Str: sp("c")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a", "d", "e"}, Str: sp("e")},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"a"}},
		}},
		{Name: "crlf document", Input: "a = 1\r\n\r\n[t]\r\nx = 2\r\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"b"}, Str: sp("x")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"u", "k"}, Str: sp("y")},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"t"}},
		}},
		{Name: "quoted keys", Input: "\"a b\" = 1\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a b"}, Str: sp("q")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"c.d"}, Str: sp("dot")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{""}, Str: sp("empty")},
		}},
		{Name: "invalid edits leave doc unchanged", Input: "a = 1\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a"}, Raw: sp("[")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"a"}, Raw: sp("   ")},
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{}, Str: sp("x")},
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{}},
		}},
		{Name: "heal indexed run tables", Input: "setup_cmd = 'make setup'\n\n[run.0]\nname = 'dev'\ncmd = 'old'\n", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "delete", Key: []string{"run"}},
		}},
		{Name: "array table element without newline", Input: "[[r]]\nn = 1", Ops: []rustOp{
			{Op: "set", Key: []string{"r", "1", "n"}, Str: sp("two")},
		}},
	}
	for ei := range edits {
		e := &edits[ei]
		d, err := edit.Parse([]byte(e.Input))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: parse: %v", e.Name, err)
		}
		for oi := range e.Ops {
			op := &e.Ops[oi]
			switch op.Op {
			case "set":
				var v interface{}
				switch {
				case op.Raw != nil:
					v = unstable.RawMessage(*op.Raw)
				default:
					v = *op.Str
				}
				op.Err = d.Set(op.Key, v) != nil
			case "delete":
				op.Found = d.Delete(op.Key)
			}
			op.Out = d.String()
		}
	}

	writes := []rustWrite{
		{Name: "fresh full", Project: domain.Project{
			SetupCmd: "pnpm install", TeardownCmd: "rm -rf node_modules",
			RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "dev", Cmd: "pnpm dev --port $RECUR_PORT"}, {Name: "test", Cmd: "go test ./...\ngo vet ./...\n"}},
			AppURL:      "http://localhost:$RECUR_PORT", Env: "FOO=bar\n# comment\nBAZ=$HOME", CopyFiles: ".env*\napps/**/.env.local",
		}},
		{Name: "fresh empty", Project: domain.Project{}},
		{Name: "fresh quotes", Project: domain.Project{SetupCmd: "echo 'hi'", Env: "A=\"\"\"\n\tB=1\r\n", AppURL: "x\ty"}},
		{Name: "fresh unnamed runs", Project: domain.Project{RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Cmd: "a"}, {Name: "dev", Cmd: "b"}, {Name: "dev", Cmd: "c"}}}},
		{Name: "merge keeps comments", Existing: sp("# team notes\n\n# secrets stay in .env\nenv = \"\"\"\nFOO=old\n\"\"\"\n\nextra = \"keep-me\"\n\n[[run]]\n# local override\nname = \"dev\"\ncmd = \"make dev\"\n"), Project: domain.Project{
			Env: "FOO=new\nBAR=2\n", RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "dev", Cmd: "make dev"}, {Name: "test", Cmd: "go test"}},
		}},
		{Name: "merge adds runs", Existing: sp("# Recur project settings\nsetup_cmd = 'make setup'\nteardown_cmd = ''\napp_url = ''\nenv = 'A=1'\ncopy_files = ''\n"), Project: domain.Project{
			SetupCmd: "make setup", Env: "A=1", RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "dev", Cmd: "make dev"}},
		}},
		{Name: "merge drops runs and dev_cmd", Existing: sp("dev_cmd = \"legacy\"\nsetup_cmd = \"x\"\n\n[[run]]\nname = \"a\"\ncmd = \"b\"\n\n[[run]]\nname = \"c\"\ncmd = \"d\"\n"), Project: domain.Project{SetupCmd: "x"}},
		{Name: "merge shrinks runs", Existing: sp("[[run]]\nname = \"a\"\ncmd = \"b\"\n\n[[run]]\nname = \"c\"\ncmd = \"d\"\n\n[[run]]\nname = \"e\"\ncmd = \"f\"\n"), Project: domain.Project{RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "z", Cmd: "multi\nline"}}}},
		{Name: "merge heals indexed tables", Existing: sp("setup_cmd = 'make setup'\n\n[run.0]\nname = 'dev'\ncmd = 'old'\n"), Project: domain.Project{SetupCmd: "make setup", RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "dev", Cmd: "make dev"}}}},
		{Name: "merge malformed rewrites", Existing: sp("[[[not toml"), Project: domain.Project{Env: "A=1"}},
		{Name: "merge table where string expected rewrites", Existing: sp("[env]\nx = 1\n"), Project: domain.Project{Env: "A=1"}},
		{Name: "merge inline run array", Existing: sp("run = [{name = \"a\", cmd = \"b\"}]\n"), Project: domain.Project{RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "a", Cmd: "b2"}, {Name: "c", Cmd: "d\ne"}}}},
		{Name: "merge scalar run", Existing: sp("run = 'x'\nsetup_cmd = 'y'\n"), Project: domain.Project{SetupCmd: "y", RunCommands: []domain.RunCommand{{Name: "a", Cmd: "b"}}}},
		{Name: "merge clears values", Existing: sp("setup_cmd = 'a' # keep comment\ncopy_files = \"\"\"\nx\n\"\"\"\n"), Project: domain.Project{}},
	}
	for i := range writes {
		w := &writes[i]
		dir := t.TempDir()
		path := filepath.Join(dir, "project.toml")
		if w.Existing != nil {
			if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(*w.Existing), 0o644); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		data, err := encodeProjectFile(path, w.Project)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", w.Name, err)
		}
		w.Output = string(data)
	}

	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"edit": edits, "write": writes}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
